summary: Exact preregistered LazySP-style (A* optimistic shortest path, lazy node-query evaluation, Forward/Reverse/Alternate selectors) baseline run on the frozen 100-episode panel with the identical oracle, initial observations, budget and ledger certificate. Primary lazysp_alternate resolves 96/100 at 1000 assays vs saved q2c 78/100 (+0.18, seed-cluster bootstrap [0.14,0.22]) but RMST difference -6.5 [-53.5,+48.9] includes 0; the gap is concentrated in one problem (VFVS->ALKG) and a post hoc 24-problem-cluster bootstrap gives [0.00,0.51]. Secondary forward: 96/100, RMST 369.6; reverse: 49/100. Zero false certificates, 300/300 shards independently audited. Original Q2C is not demonstrated to beat a lazy path-search baseline; not a claim LazySP is better in general.
